newsitem.title: UK: UK utilities up on optimism ahead of windfall tax.
newsitem.headline: UK utilities up on optimism ahead of windfall tax.

text.p: Shares in National Power Plc and PowerGen Plc rose on Thursday along with most other privatised utilities on optimism about the size of the planned windfall tax.
National Power climbed 12p to 522 and PowerGen was up 13p to 714. Others in the electricity and water sectors climbed in tandem.
Traders said utility stocks were benefiting from fresh hopes that the government's planned windfall tax, to be announced in next week's budget, would be lower than most analysts had feared.
